1TH.1.1-1.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy greet the church

1TH.1.2-3.text: Paul thanks God for the believers’ faith, love, and hope

1TH.1.4-5.text: Paul knows God chose them; the gospel came with power

1TH.1.6-7.text: The Thessalonians followed Paul and became an example

1TH.1.8-10.text: Everyone hears how the Thessalonians turned to God

1TH.2.1-2.text: Paul spoke the gospel boldly in spite of suffering

1TH.2.3-4.text: Paul’s message came from God, not from trickery

1TH.2.5-6.text: Paul never flattered them or sought praise

1TH.2.7-9.text: Paul cared for them like a mother and worked hard

1TH.2.10-12.text: Paul acted like a father to each of them

1TH.2.13-13.text: The Thessalonians accepted the message as God’s word

1TH.2.14-16.text: The Thessalonians suffer as the Judean churches did

1TH.3.1-3.text: Paul sent Timothy from Athens to strengthen them

1TH.3.4-5.text: Paul feared the tempter had made his work useless

1TH.3.6-7.text: Timothy brings good news about their faith and love

1TH.3.8-10.text: Paul thanks God and prays to see them again

1TH.3.11-13.text: Paul prays to visit them and that their love grows

1TH.4.1-2.text: Paul urges believers to live to please God

1TH.4.3-6.text: God wants believers to be holy and avoid sexual sin

1TH.4.7-8.text: God called believers to holiness, not impurity

1TH.4.9-12.text: Paul urges believers to love more and work quietly

1TH.4.13-15.text: Believers who died will be with Jesus; do not grieve

1TH.4.16-18.text: The Lord will come, and believers will meet him

1TH.5.1-3.text: The Day of the Lord will come suddenly

1TH.5.4-7.text: Believers belong to the day and must stay alert

1TH.5.8-11.text: God has appointed believers to salvation, not wrath

1TH.5.12-14.text: Paul urges believers to respect leaders and help the weak

1TH.5.15-18.text: Believers should do good, rejoice, pray, and give thanks

1TH.5.19-22.text: Believers must test everything and hold to what is good

1TH.5.23-24.text: Paul prays that God will keep them blameless

1TH.5.25-28.text: Paul asks them to pray and to read this letter to all
